title: Seeing Beyond the Obvious: Complementary Semantic Guidance for Salient Single-Positive Multi-Label Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.25986v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Salient Single-Positive Multi-Label Learning (SalSPML) assigns each image its most salient positive label, leaving other classes unlabeled. Existing methods construct class-level Salient Prototypes from observed positives to guide the recognition of unobserved classes. However, since salient annotations favor visually prominent instances, these prototypes may not fully capture the visual diversity of hidden positives, resulting in insufficient positive supervision. To address this limitation, we propose CoST, a Coverage-guided Complementary Soft-Target Refinement framework that supplements Salient Prototypes with complementary class-semantic information. Specifically, CoST identifies semantically relevant candidates from unknown classes by leveraging task-learned category information and image-text semantic correspondence. translated_title: 看见显而易见之外：显著单正样本多标签学习的互补语义引导
translated_abstract: 显著单正样本多标签学习为每张图像分配其最显著的正标签，而将其他类别留为未标注。现有方法从已观察到的正样本中构建类别级显著原型，以引导未观察类别的识别。然而，由于显著标注偏向视觉上突出的实例，这些原型可能无法充分捕捉隐藏正样本的视觉多样性，导致正样本监督不足。为解决这一局限，我们提出了CoST，一种覆盖引导的互补软目标细化框架，通过互补的类别语义信息来补充显著原型。具体而言，CoST利用任务学习的类别信息和图像-文本语义对应关系，从未知类别中识别语义相关的候选样本，随后将选出的候选样本聚合为类别级覆盖原型，以补充语义表示。
tldr: 提出CoST框架，利用图像-文本语义对应从未知类别中挖掘互补候选样本并构建覆盖原型，弥补显著原型对隐藏正样本视觉多样性捕捉不足的问题，提升显著单正多标签学习的监督效果。
en_tdlr: CoST, a coverage-guided complementary soft-target refinement framework, mines semantically relevant candidates from unknown classes via image-text semantic correspondence and aggregates them into Coverage Prototypes to complement Salient Prototypes, addressing insufficient positive supervision in salient single-positive multi-label learning.
